purpose: One physically walkable postern supply loop using three already-authored roadside salvage nodes plus the canonical Waystation cache. No new POI, no drop-rate authorship, no continent redesign.

atlas: SYS-50 static terrain + independent furniture/inventory instances
provenance.a3_alias_decision: SPLIT: A3 opening_marches is an economy proposal region alias, not an A1 region_id. A1 binds it to r_ashen_crown for this corridor only; A3 must bind per-instance economics before production loot.

source_classes.note: A class is a reusable supply vocabulary. It is never a POI identity and never a single world object.
Distinct physical instance inside poi_crown_waystation. Its existing canonical cache_restock reward/cooldown remains byte-locked; A1 does not re-author it.

instances.label: Postern verge crate
instances.revisit: Return along the same gravel spur to the postern road; the container is not a one-way teleport or a new map marker.

instances.revisit: The lay-by connects back to the verge path and the Waystation retreat lane.

instances.label: Ashen Waystation external cache
instances.revisit: Existing Waystation retreat loop returns to the postern; canonical restock remains A0/A3-owned.

route.hazard_policy: All required cells must be walkable and hazard-free in the authored chunk. Do not disable hazards to pass.

native_scope.a0_mount: Compose the existing 448x256 connector annex first; apply only this corridor detail overlay and props inside chunk:6:3; mount the three roadside container bodies and the existing slice obstacles; bind A3 instance economics separately; keep SaveService authority.
native_scope.a3_mount: Bind each si:* instance to approved source records/loot tables and atomic receipts. A1 supplies no rates, yields or timers for the three roadside instances.
native_scope.a8_mount: A8 site interaction engine is not imported by this corridor. See a8_site_transforms.v1.json for the separate southern POI transform review.
